seo.description: Reveal anonymous website visitors and convert them with our Web Traffic Revealer. Identify hidden prospects for better leads and conversions. Try now.

faqs.q: What is MarketJoy’s Web Traffic Revealer?
faqs.a: Web Traffic Revealer is an AI-powered platform that uncovers anonymous invisible website visitors on your website, matches them to verified companies and contact data, then activates a sales outreach program to turn invisible traffic into qualified opportunities.

faqs.q: How does it identify anonymous visitors?
faqs.a: Our tracking pixel & buyer intent database maps this anonymous site activity to verified firmographic & contact data, revealing who’s visiting, what product or service they’re researching, & their level of purchase intent.

faqs.q: Is this compliant with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)?
faqs.a: Yes. Web Traffic Revealer only uses compliant, privacy-safe firmographic & intent data. No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected without consent.

faqs.q: What data do I get access to?
faqs.a: You’ll receive detailed reports on visitor companies and firms, key contacts, pages viewed, webpage engagement scores, and real-time alerts for high-intent website visitors

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything on my website?
faqs.a: Yes, a lightweight tracking pixel needs to be installed that can be integrated easily with your CMS or tag manager (like Google Tag Manager). This setup usually takes under 10 minutes.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with my CRM or marketing automation system?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We support native & API-based website integrations with leading CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, & others to sync the lead data seamlessly

faqs.q: What kind of results can I expect?
faqs.a: On an average, our clients usually capture 30–40% more qualified leads from their existing traffic and reduce the load on the internal sales team by up to 25%.

faqs.q: Do you offer managed services or is it self-serve?
faqs.a: Web Traffic Revealer can be fully managed by MarketJoy, including the installation process, monitoring, & outbound engagement, or used in a self-serve model for internal teams.
Simply click “Request a Demo” or “Talk to an Expert.” Our team will review your website traffic potential & set up a personalized demo within 48 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is MarketJoy’s Web Traffic Revealer?

Web Traffic Revealer is an AI-powered platform that uncovers anonymous invisible website visitors on your website, matches them to verified companies and contact data, then activates a sales outreach program to turn invisible traffic into qualified opportunities.

How does it identify anonymous visitors?

Our tracking pixel & buyer intent database maps this anonymous site activity to verified firmographic & contact data, revealing who’s visiting, what product or service they’re researching, & their level of purchase intent.

Is this compliant with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)?

Yes. Web Traffic Revealer only uses compliant, privacy-safe firmographic & intent data. No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected without consent.

What data do I get access to?

You’ll receive detailed reports on visitor companies and firms, key contacts, pages viewed, webpage engagement scores, and real-time alerts for high-intent website visitors

Do I need to install anything on my website?

Yes, a lightweight tracking pixel needs to be installed that can be integrated easily with your CMS or tag manager (like Google Tag Manager). This setup usually takes under 10 minutes.

Can it integrate with my CRM or marketing automation system?

Absolutely. We support native & API-based website integrations with leading CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, & others to sync the lead data seamlessly

What kind of results can I expect?

On an average, our clients usually capture 30–40% more qualified leads from their existing traffic and reduce the load on the internal sales team by up to 25%.

Do you offer managed services or is it self-serve?

Web Traffic Revealer can be fully managed by MarketJoy, including the installation process, monitoring, & outbound engagement, or used in a self-serve model for internal teams.

How do I get started?

Simply click “Request a Demo” or “Talk to an Expert.” Our team will review your website traffic potential & set up a personalized demo within 48 hours.
